name: puzzle-bench
description: puzzle-bench is a text benchmark composed of puzzles and brainteasers designed to evaluate model problem-solving and multi-step reasoning. Items include logic, spatial, and verbal puzzles requiring deduction and sometimes arithmetic or combinatorial reasoning. The benchmark measures whether models can produce correct solutions rather than stylistic outputs.
reputation: A small community dataset for probing reasoning and problem-solving; limited adoption and primarily used in exploratory evaluations.
